description.zh:
应用组ID。

系统允许您通过应用组ID指定查询一个或多个应用组信息，您一次最多可以查询10个指定的应用组信息。
description.en:
The application group ID.

You can query information about one or more application groups by specifying their IDs. You can query up to 10 application groups at a time.

description.zh:
应用组名称。

系统允许您通过应用组名称指定查询一个或多个应用组信息，您一次最多可以查询10个指定的应用组信息。
description.en:
The application group name.

You can query information about one or more application groups by specifying their names. You can query up to 10 application groups at a time.

description.zh:
列表分页查询时每页展示的应用组个数。

取值范围：**1**~**100**。

默认值：**20**。
description.en:
The number of application groups to return on each page.

Valid values: **1** to **100**.

Default value: **20**.
The token for the next page of results.

description.zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~)查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID.

Call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query the regions and their IDs that Smart Access Gateway supports.
